notes: The hosted edition includes the country roster, source snapshot administrative boundaries, and a capital-city starter corpus. It does not include every city.
Full GeoNames import runs separately against a persistent database; the source project includes the complete, unfiltered importer and paginated API.
Natural Earth first-level geography is a maintained cartographic snapshot and contains dated divisions. It is not a certified current administrative register.
Second-level coverage in this release is India (2021), USA (2018), Russia (2017). Other levels remain a recorded gap.
Boundary-source IDs and GeoNames admin paths are separate; unmatched links are labelled, never guessed.
No Mapillary imagery has been verified without a configured client token. Mapillary imagery availability is checked at play time.
